chapter.verse: Jesu in mun khat ah thungen a, a man ciangin a nungzuite khat in, "Topa aw, John in a nungzuite thunget ding a hilh bangin kote zong hong hilh in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: "Thu na nget uh ciangin hih bangin ci un: "Pa aw, na min siangtho kizahtak hen.
A nisimin kote' khamkhop an hong pia in.
A hong khialte maisak khinzo ka hih bangun ko' khialhna zong hong maisak in.
Tua ciangin hih bangin gensuak hi: "Note lakah khatpeuh in lawm nei henla zankim laitak tua a lawm' kiangah pai-in, 'Lawm aw, anlum pum thum hong leitawisak in.
A hang pen ka lawmte khat a khualzinna pan hong tung a, ama' mai-ah ka luui ding bangmah ka nei kei hi,' ci hileh
a lawm in inn sungpanin, 'Hong nawngkaisak kei in. Kongpi kikhak khinzo a, ka naupangte tawh ka lum khinzo hi. Bang khatpeuh pia dingin kong tho nawn kei ding hi,' ci ding hilo hiam?
Note kong cihin ah lawm ahihna ciang tawh amah tho tuanlo-in bangmah pia tuanlo ding hinapi, nget teiteina hangin amah tho-in a kisap bangbang pia ding hi.
Tua hi a, note kong cihin ah: ngen un, hong kipia ding hi; zong un, na mu ding uh hi; kiu un, hong kihon ding hi.
A hang pen a ngen khempeuh in ngahin a zong khempeuh in mu a, kong a kiu khempeuh kong kihon ding hi.
Note' lakah pa hinapi a ta in ngasa ngen leh ngasa sangin gul a pia ding,
aktui ngen leh aikam a pia ding, na om uh hiam?
Tua hi a, note a gilo hinapi-in na naupangte uh nahoihte guatzia ding thei na hih uhleh vantung Pa in a ngente' tungah Kha Siangtho hong guanzaw kan lai ding hilo hiam?"
Tu-in Jesu in dawi a pau theilo khat hawlkhia a, dawi a paikhiat ciangin a pau theilo mipa hong pau ahih manin mite in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
Ahih hangin mi kimkhat in, "Hih mipa dawi a hawlkhiat pen dawi-uk mangpa Beelzebul' min tawh hi," ci uh hi.
A dangte in amah a zia-etnop manun vantung pan kihilna lim khat kal uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' ngaihsutna thei ahih manin amaute' kiangah hih bangin ci hi: "Amahmah a kiphelkhap leh kumpigam khempeuh kisia ding a, a kikhenkham innkuan puk ding hi.
Tua mah bangin Satan amahmah kikhenkham leh ama' kumpigam bangci kip ding ahi hiam? Beelzebul' min tawh dawi hawlkhia nong cih manun hih hong dong ka hi hi.
Ahi zongin Beelzebul' min tawh dawi hawlkhia ka hihleh na tate un kua' min tawh hawlkhia ahi uh hiam? Tua hi a, amau pen note' thukhen hong hiding uh hi.
Ahih hangin dawi ka hawlkhiat pen Pasian' vangliatna tawh ahihleh note' tungah Pasian' kumpigam hong tung ta ahi hi.
Mi thahatpa khat in galvan a kimtak tawh ama' innpi a cin ciangin a neih a lamte lungmuanhuai-in om hi.
Ahih hangin amah sanga a thahatzaw khat in amah simin zo a, a muan a suan a galvante lakkhiatsakin a neihsa teng a pawlte tawh hawm hi.
Kei tawh a pangkhawm lo peuhpeuh kei hong langpang hi a, kei tawh a kholkhawm lo peuhpeuh a thehthang ahi hi.
"Mi khat sungpan kha nin a paikhiat ciangin tui omlohna mun teng nawkin khawlmun a zon hangin mu lo hi. Tua ciangin amah in, 'Ka paikhiatna phual ka inn ah ka ciahkik ding hi,' ci hi.
A tun ciangin tua inn kihah kipuahin om mu hi.
Tua ciangin amah va pai-in amah sangin a gilozaw kha a dang sagih tonpih a, inn sungah lutin teeng uh hi. Tua hi a, tua mipa' omzia a nunung pen a masa sangin siazaw hi."
Hih thute a gen laitak mihonpi sungpan numei khat in a aw sangkhanin, "Nang hong paai naubu leh nang hong kivakna nawibu thuphangah ahi hi!" ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, "Pasian' thu za-in a zui mite thuphangah hizaw hi!" ci hi.
Mihonpi hong tam semsem ciangin Jesu thugen kipan hi: "Hih khangmite khangmi gilo ahi hi. Kihilna lim khat kal uh a, ahih hangin Jonah' lim longal a dang kipia lo ding hi.
Tua hi a, Jonah pen Nineveh khuamite' ading kihilna lim ahih bangin Mihing' Tapa zong tu-a khangmite' ading kihilna lim hiding hi.

Thukhenna hun ciangin hih khangmite' gei-ah Leitawlam kumpinu dingto-in amaute mawhsak ding hi. A hang pen amah Solomon' pilna kam a ngai dingin leitung mongte pan hong pai ahih man hi. En un, Solomon sangin a thupizaw khat hih takah om hi.

Thukhenna hun ciangin hih khangmite' gei-ah Nineveh khuamite dingto-in amaute mawhsak ding uh hi. A hang pen Nineveh khuamite Jonah' thutangkona tawh kisik uh ahih man hi. En un, Jonah sangin a lianzaw khat hih takah om hi.
"Kuamah in meivak a vak khit ciangin vansenna inndei ah koih lo-in beeltung zong khuh lo uh hi. Inn sung hong lutte' khuamuh nadingin meivaktau tungah koihzaw uh hi.
Na mit pen na pumpi ii meivak ahi hi. Na mit a cidam ciangin na pumpi bup taangkim ding a, na mit a hoih loh ciangin na pumpi bup mialcip ding hi.
Tua hi a, na sunga khuavak pen khuamial ahihloh ding kidawm in.
Tua bangin na pumpi bup a mialna mun om lo-in taangkim peuhleh meivak a vangtaang in khuavak hong piak bangin na pumpi taangkim ding hi."
Jesu thu a gen laitak Pharisee-te khat in an nekhawm dingin Jesu kho ahih manin Jesu zong lutin anne dingin tu hi.
Pharisee mipa in anne ma-in Jesu a khut silsiang masa lo cih a muh ciangin lamdang sa mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "No Pharisee-te in hai leh ankuangte a pualam na sawpsiang uh a, ahi zongin note na sunglam uhah duhhop huaihamna leh gitlohna tawh na kidim uh hi.
No mihaitatte! A pualam a bawlpa mah in a sunglam zong a bawl hilo ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin tua a sunglama omte citpiak huhna-in zang hileh uhcin, en un, na khempeuh note' ading a siang ahi hi.

"Ahih hangin no Pharisee-te na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen lengmasel, lonamsia leh anteh theipuam namkimte sawm-ah-khat sumpi pia napi uhcin thumaan thutang leh Pasian' itna na nawlkhin uh hi. A dangte zong nawlkhin tuanlo-in hih thute na zuih ding uh ahi hi.
No Pharisee-te aw, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen vengkhawm innte ah tutphah hoihpen leh sumbuktualte ah zahtak hopihna na ngah nuam uh hi.
Note na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen ciaptehna neilo hankhuk, mite in a om lam zong thei lo-in a tungsan a tot uh, tawh na kibang uh hi."
Thukhun hilhcian syate khat in dawng a, "Sya aw, hih thute na gen ciangin ko hong kobawl zong na hi hi," ci hi.

Jesu in hih bangin cikik hi: "No thukhun hilhcian syate zong na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen note in mi tungah vangik a puak-hak dingte suan napi uhcin nomaumah in tua vangikte na khutmedawn nangawn uh tawh na lawng nuam kei uh hi.
Note na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen note in na pu na pate uh' thah kamsangte' ading han na bawl uh hi.
Tua hi a, note in na pu na pate uh' thah kamsangte' ading hankhuk bawl na hih manun note pen na pu na pate' gamtat thute teci a pang, a thukimpih na hi uh hi.
Tua hangin Pasian' lungpilna in thu gen a, 'Amaute' kiangah kamsangte leh sawltakte ka sawl ding a, amaute in kimkhat thatin bawlsia ding uh hi,' ci hi.
Tua pen leitung kilamkip huna kipan thahna thuak kamsangte khempeuh ii sisan, tu-a khangmite' tungah kisikkik ding cihna hi.
Tua sungah Abel' sisan-a kipan biakpiaktau leh biakinnpi kikala kithat Zechariah ii sisan dong kihel ding hi. Himah hi, ke'n kong cihin ah hih khangmite' kiangah kisikkik ding hi.
No thukhun hilhcian syate, na dahhuaizia uh! A hang pen thutheihna kongpi tawhtang na tawikhia uh a, no lah lut lo, a lut dingte lah na khaktan uh hi."
Tua mun pan Jesu a paikhiat ciangin laisiamte leh Pharisee-te in Jesu khauhtak galbawl dingin leh a paukhialh ding deihna tawh thu tampi kheldot ding kipan uh a,
a genkhiat thu khatpeuh tawh mawhmat dingin pang gige uh hi.Pharisee-te' Silngo
